text: Hi VINA, backed by over 30 years of Korean heritage through Hyosan and ICC, the number one market share leader in the Korean LPM industry, manufactures high-quality melamine paper and eco-friendly surface materials in Vietnam for the global market.
A global partner enhancing spatial value with high-quality surface materials.
We connect people and spaces to a sustainable future with high-quality surface materials.
We practice ethical management based on honesty, transparency and corporate integrity.
Backed by 30 years of technical expertise from Hyosan Group, Hi VINA JSC is a key global manufacturing hub in Vietnam established as a joint venture between Hyosan LPL and ICC.

Powered by in-house R&D and specialized design capabilities, we produce high-performance surface materials, including LPM and finishing foil. By combining strong cost efficiency, stable capacity, and strict quality control, Hi VINA JSC delivers trusted, sustainable solution to the global market.

LPM is an eco-friendly surface material created by impregnating decorative paper with melamine and urea resins. Using only heat and pressure, it thermally fuses directly onto substrates like MDF, HDF, and PB-eliminating the need for extra adhesives.
Available in glossy, matte, semi-gloss, embossed, logo patterns, etc.

Scratch resistance, abrasion resistance, heat resistance, acid resistance, and water resistance.
→ Strong surface performance against external environments.
Blocks harmful formaldehyde emissions from the board.
→ Safe for both humans and the environment.
→ More economical compared to alternative materials.

projects.title: JW Marriott Phu Quoc Emerald Bay
paragraphs: Nestled along the pristine shores of Khem Beach, Phu Quoc Island, JW Marriott Phu Quoc Emerald Bay is a luxurious 5-star beachfront resort designed by renowned architect Bill Bensley. Inspired by a whimsical French colonial university, the resort features 244 rooms, suites, and villas, each offering elegant interiors and beautiful ocean views.

HI VINA is honored to contribute to this iconic resort with HI 6088 melamine paper, selected for the flooring surfaces. With its refined wood-inspired appearance and warm character, HI 6088 complements the resort’s elegant interiors, adding a sophisticated and welcoming touch to the overall guest experience.

projects.title: Vinhomes Smart City Tay Mo
paragraphs: Vinhomes Smart City is Vietnam’s first smart mega-urban township, located in Tay Mo – Dai Mo, Nam Tu Liem District, Hanoi. The project is built on four smart pillars: Smart Operations, Smart Security, Smart Community, and Smart Homes — delivering a truly modern 4.0 lifestyle.
Every step inside the apartment becomes part of the living experience, where smooth wood flooring welcomes the soft morning sunlight and reflects the calm rhythm of smart urban living.

HI VINA is honored to be part of Vinhomes Smart City with HI 6015 melamine paper, bringing a warm and refined finish to the flooring surfaces, perfectly complementing the overall harmony of the living space.

projects.title: The Privia Khang Dien
paragraphs: In the heart of bustling Saigon, The Privia Khang Dien stands as a new symbol of green living. Inspired by the philosophy of "living slowly with nature", the project reflects the flow of the Saigon River — strong yet gentle — through refined architecture that harmoniously blends with its natural surroundings.

HI VINA is honored to contribute to the project’s refined aesthetic with HI 2348 and HI 2315 melamine papers, creating durable and elegant interior surfaces that complement the project’s philosophy of “living slowly with nature.”

projects.title: The Ocean Resort Quy Nhon
paragraphs: The Ocean Resort is an upscale coastal retreat nestled along the pristine shores of Nhon Hoi, Quy Nhon. Spanning nearly 22 hectares, it offers a harmonious blend of distinct property types — from luxurious villas and versatile hotel suites to vibrant shophouses. Together, they form a symphony of emotions and experiences, embraced by the raw beauty of nature.
HI VINA is honored to be part of this project with HI 2343 melamine paper, contributing to elegant, durable, and refined interior surfaces that complement the resort’s timeless coastal aesthetic.

projects.title: Filmore Da Nang
paragraphs: The Filmore Da Nang is a luxury residential project developed by Filmore Real Estate, the 25-story tower features 206 high-end apartments with stunning river views and boutique-style design inspired by the "Carp Turning into a Dragon" legend.
Embracing the concept of “High-Touch Living,” The Filmore Da Nang sets a new standard for refined and sophisticated living in the heart of Da Nang.
HI VINA is honored to contribute to the project’s distinctive interior aesthetic, adding a refined touch of color and character to the living spaces.

projects.title: L7 West Lake Hanoi By Lotte
paragraphs: L7 West Lake Hanoi By Lotte is a project designed and executed by Kukbo Design, with HI VINA’s surface materials selected and specified for the project (HI 2045SM) . The development features 264 hotel rooms from the 7th to the 20th floors, along with 192 residence rooms from the 7th to the 22nd floors. It is the fourth property from the L7 HOTELS by LOTTE brand in Korea and the first 5-star L7 HOTELS by LOTTE operated overseas.

Designed as a lifestyle hotel, L7 West Lake Hanoi By Lotte offers new experiences and inspiration for cultural creatives and the Millennial generation. The project has now been completed and is officially welcoming guests.

news.title: Expanding Production Capacity - A New Milestone in 2026
paragraphs: Following the stable operation of our 4x8ft impregnation line, 2026 marks another important milestone with the addition of a new 6x8ft impregnation line. This investment reflects our long-term direction: ✔ Increased production capacity ✔ Greater flexibility in size specifications ✔ Enhanced development of new collections ✔ Stronger control over lead time and planning With both 4x8ft and 6x8ft lines operating independently, we are ready to meet diverse project requirements and large-scale surface applications. 2026 – moving toward a higher standard in melamine paper manufacturing.

news.title: Hi Vina x Moc Phat - Official Launch of the Premium Melamine Collection
paragraphs: In April 2026, the HI VINA and MOC PHAT teams came together for an intimate gathering to officially launch the latest Premium Melamine Collection , marking an important step in the ongoing collaboration between the two companies. The event also introduced a new range of surface material designs developed with a focus on contemporary interior trends.

The new collection features a diverse selection of wood and stone patterns, combining natural textures with modern aesthetics. Each design has been carefully developed to provide refined surface finishes and versatile solutions for a wide range of interior applications.
Through this collaboration, HI VINA and MOC PHAT aim to offer design solutions that respond to evolving market needs while providing greater flexibility for interior projects.
For more information or to request the Premium Melamine Collection catalog, please feel free to contact our team. We would be happy to provide further details and support your project needs.

news.title: Hyosan x Yeongsan - Connection & Collaboration | Growing Together
paragraphs: HI VINA, as the legal entity and commercial representative of Hyosan in Vietnam, is pleased to recognize the continued development and cooperation between HYOSAN LPL and MFC YEONGSAN .
The partnership reflects the shared commitment of both companies to strengthening their cooperation and creating greater value through their collaboration.
HI VINA wishes HYOSAN LPL and MFC YEONGSAN continued success and looks forward to seeing their partnership achieve new milestones and sustainable growth in the years ahead.

news.title: Public Disclosure Of Environmental
paragraphs: Fulfilling corporate responsibilities in environmental protection and complying with the regulations of the Law on Environmental Protection, Hi Viet Nam Joint Stock Company announces the public disclosure of the approved Environmental Permit for its production facility at Giang Dien Industrial Park.
Permit Number: 64/GPMT-KCNKKT
Date of Issue: March 31, 2026
Issuing Authority: Management Board of Industrial Zones and Economic Zones of Dong Nai Province
Permit Validity: 10 years (until March 31, 2036)
Location Information: Lot 03, Road No. 4, Giang Dien Industrial Park, Trang Bom, Dong Nai Province.

The public disclosure of this permit is a testament to HI VINA's commitment to operating modern production facilities, strictly controlling environmental parameters, and striving for sustainable development.
We believe that every melamine sheet delivered to our customers not only achieves the highest aesthetic quality but is also created through a clean, socially responsible production process.
